Title: 491709-2026: Italy – Engineering services – COMUNE DI GIFFONI VALLE PIANA - Technical services for drafting the P.F.T.E., including drafting the geological and geotechnical investigation plan and assistance with its execution, drafting the Geological Report, C.S.P., Site Supervision, C.S.E. for the project Giffoni Multimedia Valley Arena Grandi Eventi - 2nd functional completion lot
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Arena for major events with structural and geotechnical design as well as site supervision and CSE corresponds to sbp’s core areas (long-span roofs/sports buildings). Location in Italy slightly reduces the priority, but it remains highly relevant.
titel: Giffoni Multimedia Valley Arena Grandi Eventi – 2nd functional lot, technical design and supervision services
kurzbeschreibung: Award of engineering and supervision services (including preliminary design P.F.T.E., geological and geotechnical investigations, safety coordination, site supervision) for the 2nd construction phase of the "Giffoni Multimedia Valley" arena for major events in Giffoni Valle Piana.
wettbewerb_art: Award of engineering and design services (open procedure, no architectural design competition)
gewinner: RTP "Giffoni Multimedia Valley Arena Grandi Eventi - II lotto funzionale di completamento" led by Eng. Nicolino Petracca with Fabio Caiazzo, Studio Tecnico Associato Russomando, Eng. Nicola Furcolo, Eng. Martina Piracci, Eng. Alfonso Giuliano, Eng. Francesca Carrozza, Eng. Maria Pia Russomando, Arch. Giovanna Di Muro, Eng. Giorgia Di Muro
gewinner_rolle: Engineering and design team (structural/specialist design, geology/geotechnics, site supervision, safety coordination)
gewinner_kontakt:
Contract value: 212522.98 EUR (excluding VAT)
Leader of RTP: Eng. Nicolino Petracca, VIA FONDO DATTERO 50, 84131 Salerno (SA), Italy, e-mail: nicolino.petracca@ordingsa.it, tel.: +39 371 4786938
Member: Studio Tecnico Associato Russomando, Via V. Fortunato snc, 84095 Giffoni Valle Piana (SA), Italy, e-mail: italo.dalessio@ordingsa.it, tel.: +39 089 866383
projektbeteiligte:
- Client: CUC SELE PICENTINI on behalf of the Comune di Giffoni Valle Piana, Via D. Manin 23, 84092 Bellizzi (SA), Italy, e-mail: cucselepicentini@pec.comune.bellizzi.sa.it
- Engineering/design team (RTP): leader Eng. Nicolino Petracca (tenderer/winner), with Fabio Caiazzo, Studio Tecnico Associato Russomando, Eng. Nicola Furcolo, Eng. Martina Piracci, Eng. Alfonso Giuliano, Eng. Francesca Carrozza, Eng. Maria Pia Russomando, Arch. Giovanna Di Muro, Eng. Giorgia Di Muro (all tenderers/winners)
- Reviewing authority: Tribunale di Salerno, Piazzetta S. Tommaso d’Aquino 3, 84100 Salerno (SA), Italy
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Arena/event building (sports and event use) with potentially interesting roof and grandstand structure
- Services include technical design and site supervision, potentially including structural design
- Project size moderate (fee volume approx. 0.21 million EUR), presumably medium construction volume
- Location Italy, not a strategic target region such as Africa, but generally international
- Structural design and overall design already awarded to a local RTP, limited cooperation potential
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project is located in Italy, checking engineer services according to the German system not directly applicable
- No explicit tender for independent checking services; site supervision/CSE already part of the awarded package
- Presumably medium-sized project, rather locally/regionally oriented arena
- No location in Germany, therefore low relevance for the sbp checking team
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs stated in the TED text; based on the fee (approx. 212 thousand EUR) no reliable cost estimate can be derived without knowledge of the Italian fee structure.
naechste_schritte: No active steps recommended. Observe the project, but do not make contact, as design and supervision services (including presumably structural design) have already been fully awarded to a local RTP and no separate checking engineer mandate is apparent.
notes: Scope of services according to the notice: preparation of the P.F.T.E. (preliminary design project), geological and geotechnical investigations including investigation plan and assistance with execution, geological expert reports, safety and health coordination (CSP/CSE), site supervision (Direzione Lavori) for the 2nd functional section of the Giffoni Multimedia Valley Arena Grandi Eventi. Award criteria strongly quality-oriented (90% quality, 10% price).
